runs.name: wire-faults256-opt
runs.scope: WRITE extension on the pinned sector fault responder; checksum stimulus flips the adapter checksum after payload transmission. The model ACKs that malformed frame but never completes it; timeout/offline is required. Command NAK uses an invalid sector. Device error replaces the real terminal C after physical mutation. These are functional tests, not interrupt timing measurements.

limits: Selected development coverage only; no release qualification or physical-device claim.
Functional suites record rotation-delay overrides while retaining physical SIO; native DOS producer settings are independent.
Metadata observer injects lost completion after a real write reply; not every peripheral/torn-sector failure is modeled.
Maximum-volume reclaim latency and exhaustive failure/timing matrices remain unqualified.
Initial allocation is assumed consistent; mount remains one header read, with no resident ownership audit.
No release published. Full build provenance is preserved per recorded emission, including earlier test-source variants.
